expectations.text: Early warning within 24 hours of awareness (indicating suspected unlawful/malicious cause or cross-border impact)
expectations.evidence: Within 24 hours of becoming aware... indicate whether the incident is suspected to be caused by unlawful or malicious action... and whether it could have a cross-border impact

expectations.text: Incident notification within 72 hours with initial assessment of severity/impact and indicators of compromise
expectations.evidence: Within 72 hours, submit a fuller notification... an initial assessment: severity and impact, indicators of compromise if available

expectations.text: Final report within one month (or progress report if ongoing) with root cause, mitigation, and cross-border impact
expectations.evidence: Within one month of the 72-hour notification... type of threat or root cause... mitigation measures applied and ongoing... cross-border impact; 'with a progress report at the one-month mark' if ongoing

expectations.text: Correct recipients: the CSIRT or competent authority (member-state specific), plus recipients-of-services notification where relevant
expectations.evidence: submit... to your national CSIRT or competent authority; 'you may need to voluntarily inform affected recipients of your service'

expectations.text: Applies the significance threshold: severe operational disruption/financial loss or considerable damage to others — ransomware downtime plainly qualifies
expectations.evidence: severe operational disruption or financial loss... Ransomware taking down production systems almost always clears this bar
